newsitem.title: USA: Center Financial shareholders OK merger.
newsitem.headline: Center Financial shareholders OK merger.

text.p: Center Financial Corp said Wednesday its shareholders have approved its proposed merger into Charlotte, N.C.-based First Union Corp.
Center Financial Corp is the holding company of Centerbank, which would be merged into First Union Bank of Connecticut, a subsidiary of First Union Corp.
The proposed merger is subject to approval by regulators.

The merger also required the approval of two-thirds of Center Financial's 15 million shares of common stock. The company said 11,727,969 shares voted in favor, 87,352 voted against and 32,863 abstained.
